cues.text: You lie face down on a rippled floor in a wide, strange hall whose walls twist in ridges. No one else is there. Slowly you push yourself up into a crouch, one hand on the floor.
You get to your feet and look around.
A few steps from you a haze gathers and takes the shape of a boy in striped pyjamas. He stands facing you, hands behind his back.
The boy dissolves back into haze and is gone. You stand alone again.
